text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Classic Triple
Crown, the
Satsuki Sho, is about to start
when Фудзи Кисэки
suddenly gets a phone
call.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She picks up to find herself greeted with
cheers
from her dorm residents. She
heads off for the
race, heart bolstered
by their sweet surprise.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
